newsitem.title: CANADA: EnerMark makes C$71.2 mln in asset buys.
newsitem.headline: EnerMark makes C$71.2 mln in asset buys.

text.p: Royalty trust EnerMark Income Fund said on Monday it entered into agreements to buy two Alberta oil and gas properties for a total of C$71.2 million.
EnerMark said it agreed to purchase 100 percent interest in the 4,912-net-acre Giltedge property, 175 km east of Edmonton.
The property currently produces 1,850 barrels per day of oil from 57 wells under a waterflood maintenance program.
EnerMark said it estimated the remaining producing life of the Giltedge property to be over 50 years.

EnerMark, which was reorganized into a royalty trust earlier this year from the assets of Mark Resources, also said it boosted its working interest in its Elmworth property in western Alberta, resulting in a net increase in natural gas production of 1.6 million cubic feet per day.

Based on current production rates and EnerMark's estimate of the reserves, the properties' combined proven reserve life index is 15.7 years and proven and probable reserve life index is 18.7 years, it said. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
